910.name: Early Peoples and Bantu Migration
910.label: Event
910.description: Khoisan hunter-gatherers; Bantu migration introduces farming, iron-working, and new linguistic families to the Zambian plateau.

910.name: Khoisan Hunter-Gatherer Communities
910.label: Event
910.description: San/Khoisan peoples as earliest inhabitants; Later Stone Age sites; Nachikufu cave culture.

910.name: Bantu Migration into Zambia
910.label: Event
910.description: Bantu-speaking peoples migrate into Zambia bringing iron smelting, pottery, and settled agriculture; displacement of Khoisan.

920.name: Pre-Colonial Kingdoms and Chiefdoms
920.label: Event
920.description: Development of major kingdoms: Lozi (Barotseland), Bemba, Lunda, Kazembe; trade networks linking central and southern Africa.

920.name: Lozi Kingdom (Barotseland)
920.label: Event
920.description: Lozi Kingdom of the Zambezi floodplain; Litunga (king); annual Kuomboka ceremony; sophisticated flood management.

920.name: Bemba Kingdom
920.label: Event
920.description: Bemba Kingdom of the Crocodile Clan; paramount chief Chitimukulu; territorial expansion; ivory and slave trade.

930.name: European Exploration and Missionary Era
930.label: Event
930.description: David Livingstone's explorations; Victoria Falls discovery; missionary stations; Lozi-British relations; slave trade disruption.

930.name: Livingstone and Victoria Falls
930.label: Event
930.description: David Livingstone reaches Mosi-oa-Tunya (Victoria Falls) 1855; transcontinental journey; anti-slave trade advocacy.

930.name: Missionary Stations
930.label: Event
930.description: Paris Evangelical Mission in Barotseland; London Missionary Society; White Fathers; Christianity and literacy introduced.

940.name: Northern Rhodesia (Colonial Period)
940.label: Event
940.description: BSAC charter; Northern Rhodesia colony; copper belt development; Federation of Rhodesia and Nyasaland; African resistance.

940.name: BSAC and Colonial Conquest
940.label: Event
940.description: British South Africa Company secures mineral rights through treaties; amalgamation of North-Western and North-Eastern Rhodesia 1911; Crown colony 1924.

940.name: Copper Belt Development
940.label: Event
940.description: Major copper deposits exploited from 1928; migrant labour system; copper belt towns; African mine workers' unions.

950.name: Kaunda and One-Party State
950.label: Event
950.description: Kaunda's humanist one-party state; nationalisation; front-line state against apartheid; copper price collapse; economic crisis.

950.name: Kaunda's Zambian Humanism
950.label: Event
950.description: Kenneth Kaunda first president; Zambian Humanism philosophy; nationalisation of mines (Zambia Industrial and Mining Corporation).

950.name: One-Party State
950.label: Event
950.description: Second Republic; UNIP sole legal party; authoritarian governance; economic mismanagement; opposition suppressed.

960.name: Multiparty Zambia and Modern Era
960.label: Event
960.description: Chiluba democratic transition; copper privatisation; presidential term debates; Lungu; Hichilema; economic diversification efforts.

960.name: Chiluba and Democratic Transition
960.label: Event
960.description: Frederick Chiluba's MMD defeats Kaunda in multiparty elections 1991; economic liberalisation; copper mine privatisation; corruption.

960.name: Copper Dependency and Diversification
960.label: Event
960.description: Copper supercycle benefits then challenges Zambia; Chinese investment; debt crisis; diversification into agriculture and tourism.
